On: gates, flags, poles and other course elements may be placed inside or overlapping each other and inside blocks – for gate-in-gate builds, tight layouts and elements set into walls or the ground. Each element still scores and collides on its own. Off (default): an element can't be placed where it would overlap another one or a block.
propwash.race_rules.adopt.tooltip: Makes the current values of all race-relevant world rules the race standard for old times. Old times without saved server rules are re-rated right away.
propwash.race_rules.assist.world_values: world rules differ from the race standard: %s
propwash.race_rules.changed.custom: %s set the race standard for old times (%s rules differ from the Propwash defaults) – old times without saved server rules are re-rated.
propwash.race_rules.changed.defaults: %s set the race standard for old times back to the Propwash defaults – old times without saved server rules are re-rated.
propwash.race_rules.command.unchanged: The race standard stays as it is.
propwash.race_rules.command.unknown: %s is not a race-relevant world rule.
propwash.race_rules.denied: You may not change the race standard on this server.
propwash.race_rules.intro: New laps are compared with the server rules: only personal deviations make them assisted. This saved race standard only rates old times flown without saved server rules (before 0.6.0-rc.3).
propwash.race_rules.overlap: There is no room here – overlapping course elements need the world rule “Free course placement”
propwash.race_rules.preflight.rules.ok: no personal deviations from the server rules
propwash.race_rules.reset.tooltip: Sets the race standard for old times back to the Propwash defaults (as before 0.6.0). Old times without saved server rules are re-rated right away.
propwash.race_rules.status.differs: The world rules differ from the saved race standard (old times only): %s
propwash.race_rules.status.matches: The current world rules match the saved race standard.
propwash.race_rules.status.unknown: The race standard hasn't arrived from the server yet.
propwash.race_rules.tooltip.neutral: Neutral for racing: never makes a lap assisted, on or off.
propwash.race_rules.tooltip.relevant: Race-relevant: a lap counts as assisted when a player's personal value differs from the server value.
propwash.race_rules.tooltip.standard_def: All race-relevant rules at their Propwash default.
propwash.race.assist.personal_rules: personal rules differ from the server rules
propwash.race.assist.personal_rules.valu: personal rules differ from the server rules: %s
propwash.rules.tier.denied: You may not change who may change the world rules.
propwash.rules.tier.header: Who may change the physics rules (fixed, zones, players):
propwash.rules.tier.unknown: %s is not a physics rule that can be released.
propwash.rules.tier.invalid: Unknown level %s – use fixed, zones or players.
propwash.rules.personal.refused: The server did not take these personal rules (not released or invalid value): %s
propwash.rules.tier.title: Release of %s
propwash.rules.tier.fixed.description: Fixed: only the server value applies – zones and players can't change the rule.
propwash.rules.tier.zones.description: Zones: zones may change the rule.
propwash.rules.tier.players.description: Players: zones and every player for themselves may change it – players includes zones.
propwash.rules.tier.kept: When you lock a rule, zone values and personal values stay saved and work again once you release it.
propwash.rules.tier.hint: Click: next level · right-click: Zones (default) · applies when you save
propwash.rules.tier.read_only: Read only: whoever may use /gamerule can change this.
propwash.rules.tab.intro: These rules apply to every player in this world and are the race standard. A preset applies at once, single rules when you save. “Release” sets per physics rule whether zones or also players may change it.
propwash.rules.my.footer: Only for you in this world – saved on the server, presets on your computer
propwash.rules.my.intro: Set your own physics here – only for you and only in this world. You can change what the server releases to players. If a race-relevant rule differs from the server value, your laps count as assisted.
propwash.rules.my.intro.none: The server releases no physics rule to players – the server rules apply to you. An admin can release rules in the World rules tab (column “Release”).
propwash.rules.my.intro.unknown: The server's rules haven't arrived yet.
propwash.rules.my.locked.tooltip: Locked by the server: release “%s”. You can change the rule once an admin releases it to players.
propwash.rules.my.locked.stored: Your saved deviation (%s) has no effect while the rule is locked – it works again once the rule is released.
propwash.rules.my.row.only_you: Only for you and only in this world. Inside zones the zone's value still applies.
propwash.rules.my.row.relevant: Race-relevant: if your value differs from the server value, your laps count as assisted.
propwash.rules.my.row.neutral: Neutral for racing: never counts as flight assist.
propwash.rules.my.row.reset: Right-click or ↺: back to the server value
propwash.rules.my.reset.tooltip: Reset %s: you follow the server value again, even if the admin changes it later.
propwash.rules.my.status.legal: Race Legal ✓ – your laps count normally
propwash.rules.my.status.neutral: Race Legal ✓ – deviations only in neutral rules, which never count
propwash.rules.my.hint: Presets live in your client config (config/propwash/personal_presets.json) and work in every world; applying one skips rules the server doesn't release. “Race Legal” means: no deviations, always exactly the current server rules.
propwash.rules.my.preset.tooltip: Pick a preset and apply it with the button next to it. “Race Legal” is built in: no deviations, always exactly the server rules.
propwash.rules.my.preset.apply.tooltip: Applies the chosen preset at once. Rules the server doesn't release to players are skipped and named.
propwash.rules.my.preset.save.tooltip: Saves your current settings (only the deviations from the server rules) as a preset on your computer, under the name in the field.
propwash.rules.my.preset.rename.tooltip: Gives the chosen own preset the name from the field. “Race Legal” can't be renamed.
propwash.rules.my.preset.delete.tooltip: Deletes the chosen own preset. Click twice. “Race Legal” can't be deleted.
propwash.rules.my.preset.reserved: “%s” is built in – pick another name.
propwash.rules.my.not_sent: Not sent – no connection to the server
propwash.rules.my.race_legal.tooltip: Clears all your personal deviations: you fly with exactly the server rules again and your laps count normally.
propwash.rules.my.race_legal.done: Race Legal: you fly with the server rules again.

gamerule.propwash.creative_fc_race_legal: On: an installed creative flight controller doesn't count as a flight assist in races – laps with it rank without assist and the leaderboard shows “Creative FC allowed”. Off (default): the creative FC counts as an assist. Admins can set this differently per course in the course settings. Other assists (creative goggles with their own latency, hold mode, personal rules …) still count; existing times keep their ranking.
propwash.race.course_edit.denied.admin_o: %1$s: only admins (operators or anyone allowed to use /gamerule) can set the creative FC rule for races.
propwash.race_rules.creative_fc.label: Creative FC
propwash.race_rules.creative_fc.world.to: Follow the world rule “Creative FC race-legal” (Gameplay group). Default for every course.
propwash.race_rules.creative_fc.assist.t: Laps with a creative flight controller always count as assisted on this course, whatever the world rule says.
propwash.race_rules.creative_fc.legal.to: Laps with a creative flight controller don't count as assisted on this course; the leaderboard shows “Creative FC allowed”. Other assists still count.
propwash.race_rules.creative_fc.denied: Only admins (operators or anyone allowed to use /gamerule) can change this – not the course creator.
propwash.race_rules.creative_fc.unsuppor: The server doesn't know this setting (older Propwash version).

propwash.race_rules.creative_fc.state.co: Applies here: %s – set for this course, the world rule doesn't apply here.
propwash.race_rules.creative_fc.badge.ti: Creative flight controller doesn't count as an assist here
propwash.race_rules.creative_fc.badge.no: Times without assist on this course may have been flown with a creative FC. Other assists still count.
propwash.race_rules.creative_fc.badge.wo: Why: the world rule “Creative FC race-legal” is on.
propwash.race_rules.creative_fc.badge.co: Why: admins set this for this course.
propwash.race_rules.creative_fc.prefligh: %s: creative flight controller – doesn't count as an assist on this course
